{{ModBox}}
'''Primed Bane of Corpus''' is the [[Prime]]d counterpart of the {{M|Bane of Corpus}} which increases the [[Faction Damage]] of rifles against {{Faction|Corpus}}.
==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Effect
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || x1.05 || 4
|-
| 1 || x1.1 || 5
|-
| 2 || x1.15 || 6
|-
| 3 || x1.2 || 7
|-
| 4 || x1.25 || 8
|-
| 5 || x1.3 || 9
|-
| 6 || x1.35 || 10
|-
| 7 || x1.4 || 11
|-
| 8 || x1.45 || 12
|-
| 9 || x1.5 || 13
|-
| 10 || x1.55 || 14
|}

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from the Void Trader [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|140,000}} and {{dc|400}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.

==Notes==
*Primed Bane of Corpus is essentially the {{M|Bane of Corpus}} mod with '''Legendary''' rarity and 5 more ranks. It is considered the same mod as its Uncommon counterpart, and thus both mods cannot be equipped together.
*Has no effect on {{Faction|Corrupted}} and {{Faction|Narmer}} Corpus (e.g. {{E|Corrupted Crewman}}, {{E|Narmer Crewman}}).
*Despite being listed as a multiplier, it will stack '''additively''' with other sources of Damage to Corpus.
**For example, if you had a [[Riven Mods|Riven Mod]] with x0.5 Damage to Corpus and a max rank Primed Bane of Corpus with x1.55 Damage to Corpus, you would have a '''1 - 0.5 + 0.55 = x1.05''' multiplier for damage against Corpus with both mods equipped.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|34.0}}
*Changed the Faction Damage Mod (includes Bane, Cleanse, Expel, Smite, Railjack, and Riven Faction Stats) descriptions to use multiplier instead of percentage based stat formatting. Damage values have not changed! Just the way they are communicated.
**For example: Smite Corpus (at max rank)
***Was: “+30% Damage to Corpus.”
***Now: “x1.3 Damage to Corpus.”
**This change better communicates how Faction Damage is calculated, since calculation occurs when you hit the enemy, as opposed to when you shoot like other damage sources (since it needs to know what Faction is being hit). For that reason, multipliers apply to final damage as a whole and not just part of the formula!

{{ver|29.10}}
*Fixed the Bane Mods applying the increased Damage twice.

{{ver|18.2.4}}
*Fixed Primed Bane of Corpus not appearing in the Codex.

{{ver|18.2.2}}
*Introduced to Baro Ki'Teer's rotation.
}}

'''Primed Chilling Grasp''' is the [[Prime]]d version of the {{M|Chilling Grasp}} [[mod]], which adds {{D|Cold}} damage to shotguns.

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from the Void Trader [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|125,000}} and {{dc|350}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.

==Notes==
*Primed Chilling Grasp is essentially the {{M|Chilling Grasp}} mod with '''Legendary''' rarity and 5 more ranks. It is considered the same mod as its Uncommon counterpart, and thus both mods cannot be equipped together.

==Trivia==
*Primed Chilling Grasp is the first primed elemental mod to break exclusivity of one primed elemental mod for each weapon category, in this case with {{M|Primed Charged Shell}}.
**Combining it with Primed Charged Shell grants shotguns very impressive damage outputs, but at the expense of far greater mod capacity requirements.
